les: Die onsigbare lyne om die aarde
kaps_punt: Lengte- en breedtegraad (grade): Breedtegraad en lengtegraad op 'n aardbol (grade)

items.bewering: Die aarde is 'n groot bal en 'n aardbol is 'n klein model daarvan.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Globe ('a spherical model of Earth'). Mapping checked: the earth is very slightly flattened at the poles, but 'bal' is a sound picture at Grade 6, and nothing later in the lesson relies on the earth being a perfect sphere.

items.bewering: Hy is rond soos die aarde self en wys waar plekke regtig teenoor mekaar lê.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Globe - a globe is 'the only representation of the Earth that does not distort either the shape or the size' of large features, so it shows true relative positions.

items.bewering: Wys nou 'n plek in die middel van die see aan. Die water lyk oral dieselfde en daar is niks om na te wys nie.
items.bron: An introductory observation, not a measurable claim: open ocean on a globe has no named land feature to point to. Wikipedia 'Globe' (land and water shown at true shape) supports the picture. It sets up the closing block, which resolves the problem correctly with coordinates.

items.bewering: Breedtegrade is die lyne wat van oos na wes om die bal loop.
items.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude ('Lines of constant latitude, or parallels, run east-west as circles parallel to the equator'); https://geo.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Geography_(Physical)/The_Physical_Environment_(Ritter)/01%3A_Essentials_of_Geography/1.04%3A_Locational_Systems/1.4.01%3A_Latitude_and_Longitude. Direction (east-west) correct.

items.bewering: Hulle loop ewewydig met mekaar en raak nooit aan mekaar nie.
items.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
items.bron: LibreTexts 1.4.01 (parallels run parallel to each other and never converge or cross); https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breedtegraad (the planes are 'almal ewewydig aan die Ewenaar'). The universal 'nooit' holds for the whole set of parallels, the equator included.

items.bewering: Die ewenaar is die breedtegraad om die middel van die aarde en hy is 0 grade.
items.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude ('with 0° at the Equator'); https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breedtegraad ('0° by die Ewenaar').

items.bewering: Van die ewenaar af tel jy tot by 90 grade noord by die Noordpool. Na die ander kant lê 90 grade suid by die Suidpool.
items.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude ('from −90° at the south pole to 90° at the north pole'); https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breedtegraad ('tot 90° by die pole' with a north or south label). Both numbers and both directions are correct, and the lesson rightly places 90 degrees AT the pole rather than calling it a line.

items.bewering: Kilometers sê hoe ver jy geloop het en 'n graad sê iets anders. Sit jou vinger op die ewenaar en skuif hom tot by die Noordpool. So draai jou vinger 'n stukkie om die bal. 'n Graad meet daardie draai en sê hoe ver 'n plek van 'n nullyn af lê.
items.bron: https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breedtegraad and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude (latitude is an angle); https://www.mathsisfun.com/geometry/degrees.html (a degree is a unit of rotation). Mapping checked: equator to pole is a 90-degree turn about the earth's centre, which is consistent with the 0-90 range the lesson gave one block earlier. Telling the angle apart from a distance in kilometres is correct, and a learner who reasons further, for example that a quarter turn gives 90, is led to a right answer.

items.bewering: Op 'n gradeboog staan die grade as klein merke langs die rand. Die merke tel die grade van 'n draai en 'n volle draai is 360 grade.
items.bron: https://www.mathsisfun.com/geometry/degrees.html ('360 degrees in one full rotation'); https://www.splashlearn.com/math-vocabulary/geometry/degree-angle-measure (a protractor scale is marked in degrees). Note, not a fault: a standard school protractor is a half circle marked 0-180. The lesson does not say the protractor shows 360, so the sentence is true.

items.bewering: Lengtegrade is die lyne wat van die een pool na die ander pool loop.
items.bron: https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lengtegraad ('van die Noordpool na die Suidpool'); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meridian_(geography) (meridians 'run between the North and South poles').

items.bewering: Die een by 0 grade loop deur Greenwich in Engeland. Ons noem daardie lyn die Greenwich Meridiaan en ons tel van hom af.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_meridian_(Greenwich); https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lengtegraad (the prime meridian 'loop deur die Koninklike Observatorium in Greenwich'); https://www.thegreenwichmeridian.org/tgm/articles.php?article=10 (adopted in 1884). The modern IERS Reference Meridian runs about 102 m east of the historical line but still passes through Greenwich (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IERS_Reference_Meridian), so 'deur Greenwich' holds under both.

items.bewering: Jy tel tot by 180 grade oos en tot by 180 grade wes.
items.bron: https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lengtegraad ('tot +180° ooswaarts en -180° weswaarts'); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/180th_meridian. Set note, not a fault: 180 east and 180 west are one and the same line (the antimeridian). The lesson does not claim they are two lines, so the sentence is true.

items.bewering: Naby die pole is die bal smaller en daarom word breedtegrade daar korter.
items.blok: Die verskil tussen die twee stelle lyne
items.bron: LibreTexts 1.4.01 (one degree of longitude shrinks from about 111 km at the equator to about 55.5 km at 60 degrees); https://home.csulb.edu/~rodrigue/geog140/lectures/geographicgrid (parallels other than the equator are small circles, smaller than a great circle). The cause given (the ball is narrower there) is the correct one.

items.bewering: Lengtegrade doen iets anders en hulle is almal ewe lank.
items.blok: Die verskil tussen die twee stelle lyne
items.bron: https://home.csulb.edu/~rodrigue/geog140/lectures/geographicgrid ('All meridians are half-sections of great circles'); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meridian_(geography) ('a great semicircle'). Each one runs from pole to pole, so all are the same length, about 20 004 km on the WGS 84 ellipsoid. On the slightly flattened earth they are congruent ellipse halves, so the claim of equal length still holds exactly.

items.bewering: Hulle staan wyd van mekaar by die ewenaar en kom by die pole bymekaar. Volg twee lengtegrade met jou vingers en hulle raak by 'n pool aan mekaar.
items.blok: Die verskil tussen die twee stelle lyne
items.bron: https://home.csulb.edu/~rodrigue/geog140/lectures/geographicgrid (meridians 'all come together at the North Pole and at the South Pole and are the widest apart at the equator'); LibreTexts 1.4.01. 'By 'n pool' is true: any two meridians meet at both poles, and the previous sentence already says 'by die pole'.

items.bewering: Elke plek tussen die twee pole van die aardbol lê waar een breedtegraad en een lengtegraad kruis.
items.bron: LibreTexts 1.4.01 ('a latitude and a longitude measurement is necessary'; parallels and meridians 'always intersect each other at right angles'). The words 'tussen die twee pole' are the correct qualifier, because every meridian meets at a pole, so a pole is not one crossing of one line pair. Observation for the moderator, not a fault: the claim is true of every parallel and meridian, not only of the few printed on a globe, and the lesson defines breedtegraad and lengtegraad as measures in its glossary, which carries that.

items.bewering: Die een getal sê hoe ver die plek noord of suid van die ewenaar lê. Die ander getal sê hoe ver dit oos of wes van die Greenwich Meridiaan lê.
items.bron: https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breedtegraad (north or south of the equator); https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lengtegraad (east or west of the prime meridian). Directions correct.

items.bewering: Sonder noord of suid en oos of wes kan dieselfde twee getalle op vier plekke pas.
items.bron: Worked out from the definitions sourced above, where latitude carries N/S and longitude carries E/W. For example, 30 and 25 fit 30N 25E, 30N 25W, 30S 25E and 30S 25W, which is four places. The word 'kan' is correct, because at latitude 0 or longitude 0 or 180 fewer places fit. The lesson has already said which number is latitude and which is longitude, so the count of four is right within its own frame.

items.bewering: Met die kant by elke getal wys die twee saam een plek. So kan jy ook 'n plek in die middel van die see aanwys.
items.bron: LibreTexts 1.4.01 (a point is located by a latitude and a longitude). Checked whether the two numbers really pick out one place: with N/S on a latitude below 90 and E/W on a longitude from 0 to 180, the pair names exactly one point. The only double label is 180E = 180W, which is still one place. The single-point problem at the poles is excluded by 'tussen die twee pole' in the same block. This also correctly resolves the open-ocean problem from the first block.

items.bewering: aardbol: 'n Klein ronde model van die aarde wat jy kan draai.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Globe ('a spherical model of Earth'; 'usually a globe is mounted so that its rotation axis is 23.5° from vertical'). Read alone, it is accurate.

items.bewering: breedtegraad: 'n Maat in grade wat sê hoe ver 'n plek noord of suid van die ewenaar lê. Op 'n kaart of 'n aardbol word dit as 'n lyn getrek wat ewewydig met die ewenaar om die aarde loop.
items.bron: https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breedtegraad; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude. Read alone, it is accurate. Tested as a set with the lengtegraad entry: the two are built in parallel (a measure, then the line drawn for it), and each pairs the right reference line with the right directions.

items.bewering: lengtegraad: 'n Maat in grade wat sê hoe ver 'n plek oos of wes van die Greenwich Meridiaan lê. Op 'n kaart of 'n aardbol word dit as 'n lyn van pool tot pool getrek.
items.bron: https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lengtegraad; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Meridian_(geography). Read alone, it is accurate.

items.bewering: graad: 'n Eenheid wat 'n draai meet; dit wys hoe ver om die aarde 'n plek van die ewenaar of die Greenwich Meridiaan af lê.
items.bron: https://www.mathsisfun.com/geometry/degrees.html (a degree is a unit of rotation, 1/360 of a full turn); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude (latitude is an angle). Read alone, the first clause is the general meaning and the second correctly gives the geographic use.

items.bewering: ewenaar: Die breedtegraad van 0 grade om die middel van die aarde.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Latitude; https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breedtegraad. Read alone, it is accurate: halfway between the poles.

items.bewering: Greenwich Meridiaan: Die lengtegraad van 0 grade wat deur Greenwich in Engeland loop.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prime_meridian_(Greenwich); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IERS_Reference_Meridian (the modern reference line still passes through Greenwich). Read alone, it is accurate.

opsomming: All 25 checkable claims are confirmed, the lesson contains no superlative (absolutes such as 'nooit', 'almal ewe lank' and 'elke plek' are each checked as items), every direction and number is correct, and with the N/S and E/W side attached the two numbers truly point to one place; two set notes need no change, namely that 180 east and 180 west are one line and that a standard protractor shows only 0-180.
